settings.heading: Your passenger seat is not a shelf.
settings.subheading: A sleeper cab is a living space that ships with no storage. We make gear sized for the actual cab — no drilling, no tools, nothing modified.
settings.image_alt: Interior of a Class 8 sleeper cab at dawn with the CS-01 fitted to the passenger seat back

settings.title: The passenger seat pile
settings.text: Phone, water, gloves, clipboard, whatever you ate at 2am. It slides when you brake and it's buried by Thursday.

settings.title: Storing things on your bed
settings.text: The wall next to your bunk is empty. Your mattress is where the bag goes. That's backwards.

settings.title: Paperwork in a door pocket
settings.text: Logs, BOLs, permits, receipts. Creased, damp, and never where you left them.

settings.heading: Everything you own lives in 60 square feet. None of it has a home.
settings.body:
Your truck was engineered to move freight. Nobody engineered it for the person living in it.

There's a bunk, a dash, and a couple of shallow cubbies. That's the storage. Everything else ends up on the passenger seat, on the bunk, or on the floor. Then you brake hard and half of it's in the footwell.

settings.title: Nothing moves under braking
settings.text: Loose gear gets secured. Elastic retention on the sleeves, deep pockets with defined positions.

settings.title: You stop hunting
settings.text: Everything has one place. You stop losing twenty minutes a week to the same three items.

settings.title: Nothing gets modified
settings.text: Straps, hangs, sits. No drilling, no bolts, no tools. Comes with you to the next truck.

settings.title: Sized for your cab
settings.text: Designed against real Class 8 dimensions. Every measurement published — check before you buy.

settings.heading: Built for the cab, not the catalog
settings.body:
Most gear sold for trucks is a car product with truck keywords in the listing title. The straps don't reach. The pockets sag. It was designed for the back of a minivan seat.

We started from the cab. Every measurement is published so you can check it against your truck before you spend anything.

settings.question: Will it fit my truck?
settings.answer: Confirmed on Freightliner Cascadia, Peterbilt 579, Kenworth T680, Volvo VNL and International LT. Every dimension is published on each product page and there's a fit guide by model. Running something else? Measure your seat back. If it doesn't work, 30-day returns.

settings.question: Can I get this cheaper on Amazon?
settings.answer: Probably, and it'll get there faster. What you'll get is a car organizer with truck keywords in the title. Ours is sized for a Class 8 sleeper and the dimensions are published so you can check. If two-day shipping matters more than fit, buy the Amazon one — we'd rather you were happy than out $55.

settings.question: Do I have to install anything?
settings.answer: No. Everything straps, hangs or sits. No drilling, no bolts, no tools. Nothing on your truck gets modified, which also means nothing to clear with your carrier.

settings.question: I'm never home to sign for a package.
settings.answer: Ship to your home address for whenever you get back, to a terminal, or to a hold-for-pickup location. If your route makes that complicated, email us before you order.
